---
title: "Parameter Inference"
subtitle: "Population and patient-level posterior distributions"
execute:
  freeze: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("_setup.R")
rates_rvar <- pub_tar_read("all_tumor_ssls_rates_rvar")
noise_sd   <- pub_tar_read("all_tumor_ssls_noise_sd_rvar")
coef_data  <- pub_tar_read("all_tumor_ssls_coef")

# Append gr_decay_coef_qr_pop (kappa covariate effects) — not included in the
# pipeline coef target, so read directly from the pop draws for each fit type.
kappa_coef_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(
  list(prior = "tumor_ssls_draws_pop_prior", posterior = "tumor_ssls_draws_pop_posterior"),
  \(name) {
    rv <- posterior::as_draws_rvars(pub_tar_read(name))
    v  <- rv[["gr_decay_coef_qr_pop"]]
    tibble::tibble(.variable = "gr_decay_coef_qr_pop", n = seq_along(v), .value = v,
                   .exp_value = exp(v))
  },
  .id = "fit_type"
)
coef_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_data, kappa_coef_rows)

# Covariate names from design matrix (same for all param types)
covar_names <- colnames(pub_tar_read("covar_design_matrix"))
```

## Population-Level Rates {#sec-pop-rates}

```{r}
#| label: fig-pop-rates
#| fig-cap: Population-level log growth and regression rates — prior vs posterior.

rates_rvar |>
  # tr_sd_level_intercept is vector-valued (one SD per hierarchy level); fold the
  # level index into the facet label so each level gets its own panel. Scalar
  # params carry level = NA and keep their bare name.
  mutate(.variable = if_else(
    is.na(level), .variable, paste0(.variable, " [", level, "]")
  )) |>
  plot_prior_post_dens(.value, normalize = "groups") +
  labs(x = "") +
  facet_wrap(vars(.variable), scales = "free",
             labeller = labeller(.variable = \(l) str_wrap(str_remove(l, "log_"), 16))) +
  NULL
```

## Measurement Noise {#sec-noise}

```{r}
#| label: fig-noise-sd
#| fig-cap: Measurement noise SD (SLD observation error) — prior vs posterior.

noise_sd |>
  plot_prior_post_hist(normalize = "groups") +
  labs(x = "Measurement SD") +
  NULL
```

## Covariate Effects {#sec-covariate-effects}

```{r}
#| label: fig-covariate-effects
#| fig-cap: Covariate coefficient posterior distributions (QR-space).

coef_data |>
  filter(fit_type == "posterior") |>
  mutate(covar = factor(covar_names[n], levels = covar_names)) |>
  ggplot() +
  stat_pointinterval(aes(xdist = .value, y = covar, color = .variable),
                     .width = c(0.5, 0.9), point_size = 1.5,
                     position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_discrete("Parameter", type = AZ_palette) +
  labs(x = "Coefficient (QR space)", y = NULL) +
  NULL
```
